prerequisiteText: Third- or fourth-year standing or permission of department

prerequisiteText: Third- or fourth-year student standing or permission of department

title: History of Christian Theology (Modern-Contemporary)

title: Christian Sexual Ethics

prerequisiteText: Third- or fourth-year student standing or permission of department

prerequisiteText: Third- or fourth-year student standing or permission of department

description: Islam as a religious and sociocultural phenomenon. The fundamental principles of the Islamic faith, Qu'ran, the Sunna of Muhammad, Islamic sectarianism, Islamic law, theology, and mysticism, and themes in Islamic art. prerequisiteText: Junior or senior standing or permission of department

prerequisiteText: Junior standing or permission of department

description: Historical, thematic, detailed study of the life of Mohammad, the prophet of Islam, from earliest sources. title: Buddhist Ritual Practices

title: East Asian Buddhism
